purpose: Define the minimal Ning Cai Slice 1 wiring across A07.9, Commerce, persistence and new equipment without modifying runtime yet.

a07.invariant: canonical mission/handler path has priority over the general conversation host
a07.rule: Commerce must not alter ROLE, SELF_INTRODUCTION or authored A07 corpus semantics.

entry: Player executes HABLAR with Ning Cai.
Existing canonical handler/mission resolution runs first.
If canonical handler handled the interaction, STOP: no commerce option and no second response.
If general A07.9 conversation surface is authorized, the host may query a read-only Commerce domain-choice provider.
If Commerce is currently available, append one DOMAIN option to the same native player-choice surface.

domain_option.rule: It is a player domain action, not NPC-authored dialogue.

handoff: Selecting DOMAIN:COMMERCE consumes/invalidates the current A07 interaction capability/lease.
Host issues a private one-shot Commerce session capability tied to actorId, room, area/session epoch and originating interaction proof.
No public npcId/reason API may fabricate a session.
commerce_surface: Slice 1 exposes BUY only for calzas_sendero_pinos plus RETURN_TO_CONVERSATION and CLOSE.
UI submits intent/identity only; no price, gate, stock or currency authority.
transaction: REVALIDATE actor, copresence, room, capability, offer, funds, gate/availability and item definition.
COMMIT synchronously with no observable partial success.
post_purchase: ROUTINE_UNLIMITED does not decrement/persist merchant stock.
Catalog remains usable while session remains valid.
return_to_conversation: A private one-shot return capability is presented to the A07 host.
Host revalidates same canonical actor, copresence, room/context, player/actor eligibility and current runtime epoch.
If valid, create a NEW A07 interaction capability and rebuild available player choices without calling cmd_hablar() or gestionarMisionesNpc().
Do not replay SELF_INTRODUCTION/opening/mission handling merely because Commerce closed.
If invalid, close to normal gameplay with no forced dialogue.
close_or_leave: CLOSE destroys Commerce capabilities and returns to normal gameplay.
Movement/room change invalidates Commerce before any later transaction.

session_invalidation: external SAVE/lifecycle boundary that invalidates A07 session authority

persistence_boundary.requirement: Successful purchase must survive save/load and must not publish a half-committed economy state.
persistence_boundary.recommended_pattern: prepare validated draft snapshot -> native durable writer -> publish RAM -> receipt
persistence_boundary.unknown_outcome_rule: If persistence outcome becomes uncertain after durable boundary, quarantine/close session; never retry the same token automatically.

equipment_dependency.productive_slice_gate: Slice 1 is fully validated only when the purchased item can later be equipped and NEW_COMBAT_STATS_V0_1 reflects +3 hp_max and +1 evasion.

recommended_availability.rule: calzas_sendero_pinos becomes visible only after real M04 completion/availability source is satisfied; min_stage alone never reveals it.

hp_current_semantics.equip: Increase max HP by equipment bonus; do not increase current HP.
hp_current_semantics.unequip: Decrease max HP by removed bonus; set current HP = min(current HP, new max HP).
hp_current_semantics.rule: Equipment swapping must never become a healing source.

explicit_non_goals: No new public comprar/vender/comerciar parser commands.
No new timer or restock clock.
required_tests: canonical handler handled -> commerce option absent and no second response
general Ning Cai conversation -> exactly one DOMAIN:COMMERCE option when eligible
domain option is not counted as an A07 authored player entry
select commerce -> old A07 capability cannot be reused
8 stones -> exactly one successful purchase and one item
double click/replayed request -> one commit maximum
forged UI price ignored; engine charges authoritative 8
movement before confirm -> session invalid, zero mutation
RETURN -> new A07 capability without cmd_hablar/mission replay
save/load after purchase preserves stones and item
equip purchased calzas -> PIERNAS contains one item; +3 hp_max; +1 evasion
second PIERNAS item rejected while occupied
unequip returns exactly one item and applies ratified HP-current semantics
